item.text: The hook currently mixes Redux cache lookups and label membership. The mailbox already has the valid `elementIDs` slice and a loading state; I’m tracing their derivation and the message-level label helper to wire the correct active ID through both view paths.

The ID validation hook and prop flow are now in place. In conversation mode, always-message labels select the route’s `messageID`; other labels select the conversation ID. I’ll run the mail package’s existing type check and focused component tests to catch any stale prop expectations.

item.text:
Updated move-out decisions to validate the active ID against the mailbox’s `elementIDs`, and defer evaluation while those elements are loading. Both views receive the mailbox IDs and loading state; conversation view selects `messageID` for always-message labels and `conversationID` otherwise. Updated the existing conversation view test props.

The type check and focused test did not finish: both commands remained silent while running, so I stopped them. `git diff --check` passed.
